Hi Sofia —

Thanks — attaching a first-pass MAP and a PO template that procurement can use. Key callouts up front:

- Recommendation: we route this as an AWS Marketplace Private Offer (PO) tied to a 12-month commitment on Dedicated or Reserved capacity for predictable unit economics. Private Offer gives you a single consolidated invoice from AWS; Redwood issues a monthly usage statement and supports pass-through billing options.
- Billing path: AWS invoices HelioMed directly for the AWS charges (including the private offer), and HelioMed will receive a consolidated monthly invoice from AWS. Redwood can provide a monthly usage report and, if needed, a Redwood tax invoice for our partner revenue share. For net-45 requests, we typically require signed PO + DocuSign and pre-approved credit terms (we can approve net-45 for enterprise accounts with legal sign-off).
- Timeline: if procurement signs the private offer and returns a completed PO within 2 weeks, we can target activation in 3–4 weeks (AWS processing + provisioning).

I've attached: HelioMed_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP with milestones/owners), PO_Template_HelioMed.docx, and AWS_Private_Offer_Guide.pdf.

I'll flag Karthik to confirm procurement checklist items on our side. Happy to hop on a 30-min call with procurement to walk through the MAP.

Thanks,

Sofia — quick clarifications on billing mechanics so procurement has accurate expectations: 

- If HelioMed purchases via AWS Private Offer: AWS will be the billing owner. AWS sends the invoice and collects payment according to the terms on the private offer (AWS billing cadence). Redwood provides a monthly usage statement and can issue an invoice to HelioMed for partner-managed chargeback accounting, but cash collection for AWS-invoiced items flows through AWS.
- Net-45: Redwood can accept net-45 for Redwood-origin invoices (e.g., for third-party add-ons or professional services), but for AWS Marketplace Private Offers the payment terms are controlled by AWS. If HelioMed needs net-45 for AWS charges, that must be coordinated with AWS account team (we can introduce you).
- Tax: provide W-9 to Redwood (if US entity) and we will include our tax information on Redwood-origin invoices.

Next steps: 1) review attached MAP and mark any milestone changes; 2) send completed PO to procurement@redwood.com and cc olga@redwood.com; 3) confirm billing contact for AWS processing.

Thanks,
Vivek
